findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_part_dimensions_bolt_pattern_cad" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: START HERE for one named object: returns its dimensions, mounting/bolt pattern, hole and thread sizes, ports, mating features with fit classes, and free STEP/ST…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
